crossing.meaning: Super-class definition preserved; class contradictions exported, not reconciled. No independent single-neuron polarity verification; never relabel every crossing neuron descending.

limitations: Source labels identify populations, not per-cell tuning or measured kinetics.
Channel substring rules inherited and explicit; bristle substring may overlap gustatory/tactile subtypes, inspect exported subclass before injection.
Nociceptive and load signals require actual physical sensing/encoding; no afferents or nerves are invented.
Same-row version association is not split/merge validation.
Legacy muscle-target pools are for90 actuators, not calibrated mappings onto current42 increments.
Muscle aliases, many-to-many pools, missing16, force/activation calibration and neuron identity qualification remain explicit.

edge_location_limit: Directed pairs are real cached pre->post aggregates across neuropils. Endpoint super-class is not a synapse location, neck tract geometry, conduction delay, efficacy or physiological sign.

local_module.recommendation: Implement identity-preserving sparse recurrent local neuron module over saved source edges; reserve descending/ascending ports and actual leg sensory/MN identities. A separate brain module may send through descending cells and receive ascending cells; no direct raw-body-to-brain or brain-to-joint shortcut. Candidate is locomotor-only, not complete brain/feeding/choice.

bounded_parameter_proposal.neuron_update: bounded point-neuron state; preserve identities and sparse source topology; dynamics and units declared
bounded_parameter_proposal.strict_label_mode: Only pure acetylcholine/gaba/glutamate source labels eligible initially; excitation/inhibition mapping remains receptor model assumption, glutamate need not imply universally inhibitory biology. Unknown/mixed/modulatory labels do not silently gain signs.
bounded_parameter_proposal.gain_partition: directed port/region groups, predeclare exact grouping before fit
bounded_parameter_proposal.external_drive: only declared physically observed leg channels injected into listed sensory identities, plus declared commands on listed descending ports; no arbitrary all-neuron bias
bounded_parameter_proposal.readout: per-leg bounded linear/tanh readout from unique leg motor ports to7 corresponding incremental joints; engineering decoder, not muscle anatomy
bounded_parameter_proposal.final_actuation: existing42-joint angle/velocity/torque safeguards; coordinate registration from parent retarget audit required
bounded_parameter_proposal.unknown_edge_policy: retained in anatomical artifact but inactive in strict dynamics; separate declared sensitivity model needed for any learned unknown sign

qualification_needed: Recompute signed incoming/outgoing port coverage before training; disconnected signed ports cannot be declared restored.
Verify sparse scatter update, exact ID projection, finite state and timestep stability without full-body simulation first.
Then bounded offline teacher imitation plus real physics validation authorized by parent, with teacher/engineered readout labelled.
Add source-backed mouth/feeding/internal-state interfaces separately; labels alone do not implement ingestion, energy balance, reward or behavior choice.
No lesion/cut/electrode experiments until full platform implemented and preoperative model frozen.
